invariants.statement: Prefer the representation, algorithm, bounded state, movement and abstraction requiring the least necessary work for an equal correctness contract.
Externally driven resident growth requires an explicit bound, budget, window or resource-exhaustion result.
Portable public execution semantics do not require floating point; fractional semantics require explicit versioned integer representation and rounding.
Managed storage has explicit ownership/lifetime and meaningful movement is explicit where representable.
Logical domain size does not imply proportional resident state when bounded equivalent execution is possible.
Successful invariant semantics do not depend on execution plan; benchmark observations are not correctness identity.
A simple scalar deterministic single-threaded path is semantic reference before optimized promotion.
Reduce work, movement and residency before SIMD, threading or specialized acceleration.
Reference runtime targets ISO C99 and core correctness does not depend on newer language/runtime machinery.
RUNE has no GPU execution contract.
Bounds, overflow, alignment and capacity failures fail explicitly rather than exceeding or silently truncating.
Browser/document/UI/application semantics remain outside RUNE.
Generic architecture requires a second real implementation need.
Performance observations bind source, workload, toolchain, platform and method; no universal benchmark inference.
Donor mechanisms do not transfer constants, source, benchmarks or authority automatically.
Exact cheap deterministic recomputation is permitted when RUNE-specific evidence supports it.
Host pointer/size types do not automatically define portable offsets, counts or serialized identities.
Requested/planned capability, cross-compilation or templates do not prove execution.
Human prose and machine contracts are separate; contradictions fail closed.
Prefer smaller implementation only when correctness, safety, portability, readability and evidence are equivalent.
